tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find games on Cassette that fit what a person wants. Every game comes with facts (devices, players, session length, age rating, download size, whether an account is needed and whether saves follow the player), its store page and a link that opens it. Returns hosted games first, then community games

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Everything Cassette knows about one game: its description, facts, price, demo, maker, screenshots, store page and play link. Use it before you recommend a game you only know from a list.

tools.name: similar_games
tools.description: Games like a given game, by the genres and tags they share (a genre counts three, a tag one). The same game always gets the same answer. Takes the same filters as search_games.

tools.name: list_genres
tools.description: The genres and the most used tags of the games on Cassette, with how many games each has, and the genres of the community games. Use it to choose words for search_games, or to see what Cassette has before you promise anything.
